deadline.value: The December 15 and April 30 dates are given without a year.
deadline.quote: December 15: Students with complete applications by this date will be considered for the university's Graduate School fellowships

gre_subject.value: The department says GRE scores are not required.
gre_subject.quote: Note that GRE scores are not required

gre_general.value: The department says GRE scores are not required.
gre_general.quote: Note that GRE scores are not required

toefl_min.value: The department asks for an Internet TOEFL minimum of 80, an old-scale figure; the Graduate School's current rule is 4.0 on the new scale, so confirm which scale applies.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum score on the Internet based TOEFL is 80

also.quote: Internet based TOEFL (IBTOEFL): 80 (if taken before January 21, 2026) or 4.0 (if taken on or after January 21, 2026)

supervisor.value: Applicants apply to a research area and the area, not a named supervisor, decides admission.
supervisor.quote: Admission and funding decisions are made by areas

funding.value: Tuition waivers, TAs, RAs and fellowships are awarded competitively.
funding.quote: Financial aid is available and awarded competitively in the form of tuition waivers, teaching assistantships (TAs), research assistantships (RAs), and university fellowships

entry_route.value: The University minimum accepts a bachelor's or a graduate degree; the department page adds no rule.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited U.S. institution, or a comparable degree from an international institution | A graduate degree from a regionally accredited U.S. institution, or a comparable degree from an international institution

notes: Four PhD areas: pure, applied and computational, financial, biomathematics. Page also mentions an Interdisciplinary Data Science degree (see the datasci note in the reply). Area directors may ask for higher TOEFL.
